profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Registrar Corp | Full-Stack (Java, Python, Node.js, Vue) | AWS | AI/LLM & RAG | REST API | Design | App Security
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years building and scaling regulatory-compliance software at Registrar Corp, a leading U.S. FDA-compliance provider serving 30,000+ companies worldwide. My work helps safeguard the U.S. food, drug, cosmetic, and medical-device supply by making FDA registration, prior-notice, and food-safety-plan compliance possible at scale. 

I work across the full stack and across eras of technology, from enterprise Java/J2EE and Grails platforms to Node.js serverless microservices on AWS Lambda, Vue.js front-ends, and Python/FastAPI AI services. Recently I've focused on applied AI: I co-developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform that makes 20+ years of specialist case notes semantically searchable using OpenSearch k-NN vectors, NER, and LLM summarization, and I architected an AI pipeline that turns client documents into regulatory-compliant Food Safety Plans with GPT-4 vision and text extraction and automated hazard analysis. 

What I care about most is end-to-end ownership and reliable delivery. I was promoted to Senior Software Engineer in May 2026 for consistent, high-quality delivery and technical leadership across our core revenue and compliance systems, where I lead code reviews, mentor engineers, and drive adoption of serverless and modern API patterns. 

Always happy to connect with engineers and teams working on cloud, AI, or RegTech problems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and drive adoption of AWS serverless patterns and modern REST API design across U.S. and offshore teams. 

Own technical direction for the company's AI/LLM and cloud initiatives, partnering with product and cross-functional teams on roadmap, reliability, and security. 

Serve as a go-to resource for legacy-system context and complex production issues, keeping revenue and compliance systems stable.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Co-developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform making 20+ years of case notes across 30,000+ companies semantically searchable (OpenSearch k-NN vectors, NER, LLM summarization, FastAPI on AWS Fargate).

Architected an AI pipeline converting client documents (PDF/DOCX/XLSX) into regulatory-compliant Food Safety Plans using GPT-4 vision and text extraction, RAG compliance checks, and automated hazard analysis.

Built Node.js serverless microservices on AWS Lambda within a 40+ service platform, including a tokenauthenticated Prior Notice Shipper REST API and Buyer/Supplier Analytics aggregating customs, FDA import, and company data from OpenSearch with XLSX export.

Owned the ContactDirect CRM sales system and Suggest-a-Rep lead-routing engine (quarterly routing rules, leadsource and sales-motion tracking, session-validation fixes) and hardened it with CSRF protection and ContentSecurity-Policy.

Built a NetSuite (ERP) API integration from scratch (OAuth, customer/address/email/VAT sync, country-code mapping, scheduled payment sync) to keep CRM and billing records consistent across client types.

Built and maintained compliance tickler renewal systems across FDA service lines (drug multi-year and multifacility, cosmetic/MoCRA, food/FCE, FSVP, radiation, BTA) and multi-currency estimates and invoicing (USD/EUR with live exchange rates).

Led the Hub/MyFDA account-security overhaul (VULN-005: BCrypt hashing, reset/set-password tokens, no plaintext passwords in the database, emails, or JWTs) plus reCAPTCHA v3 and honeypot bot protection, safeguarding tens of thousands of accounts.

Built registration e-commerce on Hub/MyFDA (multi-year drug-registration pricing UI, multi-facility ticklers, food and TTB registration, Create My Account onboarding) and integrated Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics purchase, sign-up, and conversion tracking.

positions.title: Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
Built full-stack Java features and an automated ticket-generation system with role-based authorization, backed by a MySQL database.

Developed the front-end with HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, and jQuery. 

Completed final-year engineering project training in industrial automation, earning certification for the project Rotary Automated Multilevel Car Parking.

projects.title: Humpback Whale Identification using Convolutional neural network
projects.description:
Humpback Whale Identification: Deep Learning / Computer Vision

Image-classification pipeline identifying individual humpback whales from fluke markings, using a CNN with VGG-16 transfer learning across a 25,000+ image dataset; documented in a full technical report.

Tech: Python, Jupyter, CNN, VGG-16, Transfer Learning, NumPy

projects.title: Group Chat Application (Android)
projects.description:
Multi-user Android group-chat application in Java with real-time messaging, delivered as a collaborative team project using Android Studio and Gradle.

Tech: Java, Android, Gradle, Google Firebase
